addresses: The link at y=516 (stop 2) is tabbed to second, but visually it sits below all other elements (stops 3-6, which are around y=320-437). A sighted keyboard user would tab to a link far below the current content, then jump back up to items above it, creating a disorienting backward jump in focus order that does not match the visual top-to-bottom reading sequence.
rationale: The two panels are tabbed in DOM order but the upload panel renders visually above the demo results (whose `dd > a` link sits at y=516), so I swap the DOM order of the two children in the page wrapper to match the visual top-to-bottom sequence without removing anything.
